title: Hits widget should support table as a valid container
body:
Here is my hits widget: ``` js search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#donations', templates: { item: '{{created_at}}${{gross_amount}} {{donor}}' } }) ); ``` My markup: ``` html
``` Apparently this code is not valid and I get this error message in the console: `Warning: validateDOMNesting(...):
cannot appear as a child of . See table > Hits > div.` Is it possible to use a `table` element as a container for hits?

comments.body:
Hmm, interesting. We use React internally for the rendering, and it uses `div`s internally. This might conflict with its internal validation when using it to render inside a `table`.

I think #707 would fix this issue as well, by letting you handle the whole rendering loop yourself in Hogan without needing React for each individual hit.

This is definitely a valid concern. @bobylito any idea on how to tell React to render a loop inside a `table` as a workaround until #707 is fixed?
Well no I don't have some magic recipe for this case :) The good thing is that it makes #707 completely valid and should be done ASAP :)

This may be easily solved if react implements the "fragment" api: https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/2127. 

In the meantime, follow #707 for a way to use tables in the hits widget.

Also, most widgets having both container and `items` template should support tables
